fields.+0x18: Final view pitch. It shortest-arc quarter-steps toward the vertical atan2 result.
fields.+0x1A: Final view yaw. It shortest-arc quarter-steps toward the horizontal target-minus-position atan2 result.
fields.+0x20: Follow/orbit heading used to place the target around Flik; R1 suppresses its angular step.
fields.+0x22_high: Signed decrementing countdown/control byte, not a stable camera submode enumeration.
fields.+0x24: Player-state-gated look/lead offset amplitude. It ramps by two between 0 and 32 and contributes sine/cosine offsets using +0x1A.
fields.+0x2A: Twelve-bit terrain/region clearance pitch accumulator. Region-query results move it by 0x20 toward 0x400 or back toward zero and may also force boom-distance contraction.
